about: GTA budget (Delta, pillar 1 numbers and money). The Scotsman reported in Sept 2013 that GTA V's combined development and marketing budget was about GBP 170 million (about $265M; conversions vary, Guinness prints $276M); a press report, not a Rockstar figure. Guinness World Records lists GTA V for Largest budget for a videogame (9 Sept 2013). Take-Two press release Sept 20 2013 (SEC 8-K Ex. 99.1): worldwide retail sales of more than $1 billion during its first three days on sale (company estimates). Take-Two Investor Presentation Nov 2026: GTA V reached $1 billion in retail sales faster than any entertainment release in history; GTA VI November 19, 2026. Derived: over $1B / about $265M = nearly 4x (3.77). Take-Two has not published a GTA 6 budget. Sources in BRIEF.md.
